headline: Nigerian All-Share Index Drops 1.83% as Heavyweight Stocks Face Selling Pressure
summary: Selling in Dangote Cement (-10%), Aradel Holdings (-10%), and Zenith Bank pulled down Nigeria's All-Share Index by 1.83% over the week.
why: The Nigerian Exchange Group lists major West African industrial and financial conglomerates.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: A 10% drop in Dangote Cement and Aradel Holdings led a 1.83% weekly decline in Nigeria's index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heavyweight industrial and banking stocks dragged down the Nigerian equities benchmark across four of five sessions.
